DXC Cybersecurity services and solutions help you assess risk and proactively address all facets of your security environment, from threat intelligence to compliance. We leverage proven methodologies, intelligent automation and industry-leading partners to tailor security solutions to your unique business needs.
Every day, we help organizations build their cyber resilience and stay ahead of evolving threats. Our mission is to secure our customers' world by combining best-in-class technology with deep expertise to create proactive, end-to-end cybersecurity solutions.
We have an extremely experienced network of cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and cyber forensic experts around the world who take care of our customers and ensure they have the cyber resiliency they need to stay one step ahead.

Our cybersecurity services
Zero Trust Solutions
Adopt a zero trust model by focusing on strategy, planning, preparation, transformation and operational management across key security domains such as identity, devices, applications, workloads and data. Start your Zero Trust journey today.
Learn more
Cyber Risk & Compliance
Gain full visibility across people, processes and IT security risks to make better business decisions. DXC helps you manage risks across the expanding enterprise perimeter, including remote working environments and the cloud. Our security risk management services help you define and deploy a risk management framework that supports your business objectives and risk tolerance.
Learn more
Infrastructure
, App & Data Protection
Secure your applications, cloud, hybrid infrastructure and endpoints from exploitation based on your unique security requirements. We design, install and integrate perimeter, network and endpoint solutions with advanced threat protection so you know you’re safe and compliant.
Learn more
Cyber Transformation & Operations
Protect your enterprise, safeguard critical assets and increase enterprise visibility with our cyber defense powered by
agentic SOC services
. We manage security operations and apply intelligent automation to protect against breaches, detect threats and ensure rapid incident response.
Learn more
Digital Identity Services
Enable people, applications and machines to verify their digital identities and securely access your data and services. We support a full range of capabilities including multifactor authentication, identity governance and privileged account management to safeguard your enterprise.
Learn more

DXC Named Leader in MDR Services by 2025 IDC MarketScape
DXC Technology has been recognised in the Leaders category in the 2025 IDC MarketScape for Asia/Pacific (excl. Japan) Managed Detection and Response Services. IDC notes DXC’s tiered MDR services and SOAR-led platform ecosystem, supported by regional centers, global hubs and partnerships, with clients highlighting responsiveness, expertise and rapid, accurate triage with minimal business disruption.
